idea-plugin.name: Codex Tabs
idea-plugin.description:
Keep independent Codex conversations in native editor tabs. Split chats beside your code and see which tasks need your attention.

  • Stream replies, commands, file changes, and generated images.
  • Create shared Git worktrees with native diffs and terminals.
  • Use slash commands, skills, context inspection, and immediate turn steering.
  • Edit earlier messages, preview attachments, and restore chats and drafts.
  • Work with local projects or Windows projects backed by WSL.

Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1 or newer with JCEF and a current Codex CLI. Uses the CLI's ChatGPT sign-in. The plugin has no separate cloud service and does not ask for an API key.

Setup and usage · Report an issue

This is an independent, MIT-licensed project. It is not affiliated with OpenAI or JetBrains.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.1 adds Git worktrees, slash commands and skills, context inspection, message editing with images, attachment previews, image copying, grouped activity, and immediate Ctrl+Enter steering.

Model choices now persist across tabs and restarts. This release also fixes restored history ordering, closed-chat cleanup, connection recovery, narrow composer layouts, and native text cursors.
